Mode: grid: infinite repetition. finite: limited number of cells each side of the origin. polar: copies rotated around an axis.
Spacing: Cell size per axis in world units. 0 disables repetition on that axis.
Count: Finite mode: cells on each side of the origin per axis.
Polarcount: Polar mode: number of copies around the axis.
Polaraxis: Polar mode: axis the copies rotate around. Offset the object from it upstream.
